# pairo

pairo is the private super-app for couples — a small, warm place made for two.
plan together, remember the little things, and feel close even when life is loud.
free during beta. iOS app coming soon.

## links

- home: https://getpairo.app/
- privacy approach: https://getpairo.app/#privacy
- FAQ: https://getpairo.app/#faq
- beta access: https://getpairo.app/#beta
